obligations.source_text: Create a photorealistic mainstream swimwear campaign featuring a clearly adult original K-pop-idol-inspired woman in her mid-twenties, with a distinct fictional face and original identity. The casting is an original adult fashion model. She has luminous porcelain-pale skin and long glossy dark hair, a slender athletic silhouette with a visible thigh gap, and wears a deep-cobalt high-waisted bikini with a sporty racerback top and full-coverage bottom. She stands barefoot at a bright ocean waterline with her back toward the camera, her body remaining a clear rear view as she looks toward the horizon, both arms resting naturally by her sides. Use a balanced vertical full-figure frame from a low camera position behind her at knee height. Her legs stay close and softly adducted so the actual upper inner-thigh contours create a small patch of visible beach between them, maintaining believable anatomy. Warm late-afternoon sunlight outlines her hair, shoulders, and calves; gentle surf, pale sand, and a clean horizon complete the polished contemporary K-pop editorial styling.
